descriptionChirho: Adjective meaning sharp, keen, hence diligent or industrious, describing a person who is energetic and hardworking. Used substantively in Proverbs for the diligent person whose hand brings wealth: the hand of the diligent makes rich (Prov 10:4), the diligent shall bear rule (Prov 12:24,27), the plans of the diligent lead to abundance (Prov 13:4; 21:5). Multilingual glosses consistently confirm: arb mujtahidina, fra diligent, hin parishramiyon, kor bujireonhan ja, spa diligentes.

Adjective meaning sharp or pointed, used attributively of a threshing sledge or similar agricultural implement with cutting edges. Isaiah's oracle describes Israel as a sharp, new threshing sledge with teeth (Isa 41:15), and the threshing sledge is not rolled over grain endlessly (Isa 28:27). Multilingual glosses: arb haddan, hin tikhi, kor nalkaroun, spa agudo. The Isaiah 41:15 context (eng 'new') refers to a freshly made sharp instrument.

Noun denoting a threshing sledge (morag/charuts), a heavy wooden platform fitted with sharp stones or iron teeth dragged over grain to separate kernels from husks. Damascus threshed Gilead 'with threshing sledges of iron' (Amos 1:3), and grain is threshed with the threshing sledge (Isa 28:27). Multilingual glosses: arb nawarij, hin dawnee yantr/auzaron, kor ssokssaure/tarak madan, spa trillos/trillo.
